# The advisories npm audit reports against the committed package-lock.json, each with why it stays.
# A new advisory fails CI, and so does a line here whose advisory is no longer reported (take it off when it clears),
# and a line past its review date.
#
# <package> <advisory id> <severity accepted at> <review by YYYY-MM-DD> <why it stays>
#
# Every line is reviewed again by its date: at most 30 days out for critical and high, 90 for the rest. A review writes
# a new date and the reason as it stands then; an update that clears the advisory takes the line off instead.
